title: Graph kind → SKOS concept (glossary)
description: How scripts/glossary-export.ts writes a graph kind (a graph typology: what a declared directory holds) as a skos:Concept in the instance's glossary, beside the roles. Work item folio-assistant-dkqd (2026-11-04): the glossary held roles only, so the words a reader meets for what the harness keeps, such as "Work item", and for the harnesses themselves were defined nowhere a reader looks words up. The label is the kind's display name (kindTitle); the definition is the kind's summary. Its siblings are glossary-node-kind-concept (the schema a file is written against) and glossary-harness-concept. The concept's IRI and @type stay in code: they are identity, not mapping. The IRI is the one the kind or harness already has (graphTypologyIri), never a second name.

target.comment: The ledger key, `kind/<kind word>`: a code, unique in the scheme (the kind `cat-harness` and the harness `cat-harness` share a word).
Prepared in code: the kind's other display names (its title when the label is not it), deduplicated and sorted.
vocabulary-authority: skos:prefLabel is the fact, dcterms:title its derived copy (bean sl9u), as for roles.
